ticker: Democrats sweep US midterms amid fallout from Iran war
India draws $400 bn in renewable energy pledges
Qualcomm signs major 5G Starlink infrastructure deal
US slaps sanctions on Indian and Turkish firms over Iran
India rolls back contentious Agnipath military recruitment provision

articles.headline: US Slaps Sanctions on Indian and Turkish Firms for Iran
articles.brief: The United States has imposed new sanctions targeting firms and individuals in India and Turkey over their alleged involvement in aiding Iran, impacting international trade and diplomatic ties.

articles.headline: Turkey Set to Ratify Defense Pact Amid Houthi Attacks
articles.brief: Turkey's parliament is preparing to ratify a major defense pact involving Saudi Arabia and Pakistan as regional Houthi attacks continue to escalate across the Middle East.

articles.headline: Qualcomm Signs 5G Starlink Infrastructure Deal with SpaceX
articles.brief: Qualcomm has finalized a major 5G infrastructure agreement with SpaceX to bolster connectivity for the Starlink Mobile network, expanding global satellite-to-cellular capabilities.

articles.headline: Qualcomm Smartphone Chip Sales Miss Estimates, Shares Fall
articles.brief: Qualcomm reported quarterly smartphone chip sales that fell short of Wall Street estimates, triggering a decline in the company's stock price amid shifting market demand.

articles.headline: Democrats Clinch Congress Control in Sweeping Midterm Win
articles.brief: Democrats secured majorities in both chambers of Congress in a sweeping midterm election defeat for Republicans, fueled by voter anger over inflation and fallout from the Iran war.

articles.headline: Trump Admits Iran War Contributed to Midterm Losses
articles.brief: Former US President Donald Trump acknowledged that the military conflict with Iran was a major factor behind the Republican Party's heavy losses in the 2026 midterm elections.

articles.headline: India Draws $400 Billion in Renewable Energy Pledges
articles.brief: India has received preliminary investment commitments worth $400 billion at the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit, aiming to expand non-fossil capacity and grid-scale storage.

articles.headline: Indian Cabinet Approves Rs 25,473 Crore Multi-Sector Package
articles.brief: The Indian cabinet has approved a financial package spanning four sectors, including critical mineral processing support and a two-year extension under the Agnipath military scheme.

articles.headline: India Puts Food Security First as El Niño Dents Ethanol
articles.brief: Severe weather patterns driven by El Niño have disrupted India's ethanol ambitions, forcing the government to prioritize domestic food production over fuel blending targets.

articles.headline: Indian Stocks Post Longest Winning Streak in Five Months
articles.brief: Benchmark Indian stock indices notched their longest winning streak in nearly five months, driven largely by renewed foreign portfolio investor inflows and positive economic sentiment.

articles.headline: High Court Rules Schools Must Address Gender Identity Bullying
articles.brief: In a landmark directive, the High Court ordered schools to actively address and prevent bullying based on gender identity and sexual orientation following a student tragedy.

articles.headline: Bihar Health Department to Launch Recruitment for 11,000 Posts
articles.brief: The Bihar government announced upcoming recruitment drives to fill more than 11,000 vacant medical and administrative posts across all 38 districts via the State Health Society.

articles.headline: Ex-Indian Hockey Captain Somaya's Olympic Medal Stolen
articles.brief: Former Indian hockey captain MM Somaya's 1980 Moscow Olympics gold medal has been reported stolen from his Bengaluru residence, prompting a police investigation.
